content: 10-30-12 The night before Halloween was “spook-tacular” as Denver’s BEST entertainers, JAMMIN’ DJs – Colorado, set up at City Pub for an AWESOME night of JAMMIN’ Trivia! We had ten (10) teams play in tonight’s battle of wits, with prizes set out for our top three (3) teams! The competition was stiff as usual tonight but at the end… The totals were close… so close in fact, that we had a tie for third place and awarded TWO third place prizes! They were Team Moorehead and Team Fishsticks ‘n Cream. Our first place team finished more than ten (10) points over everyone else, congrats Team Water Wings!

title: The Rusty Bucket	JAMMIN TRIVIA	10/31/2012
excerpt: Great night at the Rusty Bucket for some JAMMIN’ Trivia! Was fully expecting it to be a slow night with the approaching holiday but I started with 7 teams, peaked with 10 and finished with 9 teams! It was a really fun night! One team even showed up in costume! It was a close night…
content: Great night at the Rusty Bucket for some JAMMIN’ Trivia! Was fully expecting it to be a slow night with the approaching holiday but I started with 7 teams, peaked with 10 and finished with 9 teams! It was a really fun night! One team even showed up in costume! It was a close night with all the teams fighting back and forth for the top prize! But the congratulations go to team Special Ed for winning! With Exceptional Ted trailing close behind! It was a great night and I hope to see everybody back next week!
